content.user_title: Design a Compliant Email List Growth Plan
content.value_statement: Email list growth often lacks clear acquisition priorities, consent safeguards, and measurable targets. This skill creates a practical plan for incentives, opt-in flows, referrals, and performance metrics.
actual_capabilities: Plans owned, earned, and paid acquisition channels for a defined audience and growth goal.
Develops relevant lead magnet and signup incentive concepts without misleading claims.
Specifies single or double opt-in flows and the consent evidence to capture.
Designs referral mechanics with attribution and controls for low-quality signups.
Defines growth, cost, confirmation, and early engagement metrics with clear source labels.
limitations: Does not build signup pages, forms, or popups.
Does not write confirmation emails or welcome sequences.
Does not create authoritative consent records or provide legal advice.
Requires user-provided list, conversion, and jurisdiction data for tailored recommendations.

use_cases.title: Plan a Product Launch List
use_cases.description: Create acquisition channels, an incentive, and growth targets before a product launch.

use_cases.title: Build a Newsletter Referral Loop
use_cases.description: Define rewards, sharing mechanics, attribution, and quality controls for subscriber referrals.

use_cases.title: Improve Consent Quality
use_cases.description: Specify a jurisdiction-aware opt-in flow and identify the evidence captured at signup.

prompt_templates.title: Create a Basic Growth Plan
prompt_templates.prompt: Plan email list growth for [audience]. My current list is [size], and my goal is [target] by [date].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when starting with a clear audience and growth target.

prompt_templates.title: Design a Lead Magnet
prompt_templates.prompt: Design three honest lead magnet concepts for [audience] that support [offer] and explain the value of each concept.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when the signup incentive needs definition.

prompt_templates.title: Specify Opt-In and Referrals
prompt_templates.prompt: Design a [single or double] opt-in flow and referral loop for [newsletter]. Jurisdiction is [location], and current sources are [channels].
prompt_templates.scenario: Use when consent quality and referral growth must work together.

prompt_templates.title: Develop a Measured Growth Strategy
prompt_templates.prompt: Analyze my signup data, audience, offer, channels, and jurisdiction. Produce acquisition priorities, consent requirements, referral controls, metrics, assumptions, and handoffs.
prompt_templates.scenario: Use for a complete strategy based on existing performance data.

output_examples.input: Grow a developer newsletter from 2,000 to 3,000 subscribers in six months with a limited budget.
output: Priority channels: documentation content, partner newsletters, and relevant community profiles.
Lead magnet: a practical deployment checklist aligned with the newsletter topic.
Measure weekly net growth, cost per confirmed subscriber, and early engagement by source.

output_examples.input: Create a double opt-in and referral plan for an EU-focused sustainability newsletter.
output: Capture source, timestamp, consent wording, lawful basis, and confirmation status.
Reward confirmed referrals only and monitor early engagement for quality.
Ask qualified counsel to verify jurisdiction-specific requirements before launch.

output_examples.input: Improve a coaching business signup offer without making misleading free claims.
output_examples.output: Offer a concise assessment worksheet tied to the coaching topic. State the benefit accurately and explain what subscribers will receive.

best_practices: Provide current list size, growth history, audience, offer, and jurisdiction.
Label every metric as measured, user-provided, or estimated.
Confirm consent requirements with qualified counsel before launch.
anti_patterns: Do not purchase lists or reacquire suppressed contacts.
Do not present double opt-in as universally required by law.
Do not use referral rewards without attribution and quality controls.

faq.question: Does this skill build signup forms?
faq.answer: No. It specifies the strategy and capture flow, then hands form implementation to the appropriate tool.

faq.question: Can it recommend lead magnets?
faq.answer: Yes. It develops relevant incentive concepts that match the audience, offer, and expected email content.

faq.question: Does it support double opt-in planning?
faq.answer: Yes. It compares opt-in approaches and identifies consent evidence to capture at signup.

faq.question: Can it provide legal advice?
faq.answer: No. It provides general compliance guidance and recommends qualified counsel for jurisdiction-specific requirements.

faq.question: What data improves the plan?
faq.answer: Provide list size, growth history, signup sources, conversion data, audience details, offer, goals, and jurisdiction.

faq.question: How are growth targets handled?
faq.answer: Targets are labeled as measured, user-provided, or estimated. The skill avoids unsupported industry benchmarks.
